outlook.statement: Management confident of long-term prospects of newer products; pursuing avenues to revive growth momentum; exploring new market segments and applications to diversify revenue base; focused on strengthening order pipeline through deeper customer engagement, faster stabilization of newer product lines, and continued investment in R&D-led innovation.

Going forward, the Company remains focused on strengthening its order pipeline through deeper customer engagement, faster stabilization of its newer product lines, and continued investment in R&D-led innovation, and the Management of the Company remains confident that the company shall return to a stronger growth trajectory in the coming year.

risks: Subdued order inflows due to volatility in global coal prices affecting customer viability
Newer product lines yet to achieve full market stabilization
Shut down of HOCL Plant intermittently poses a risk of getting supplies as well as price fluctuations of Phenol
Fluctuation in the prices of Phenol (basic raw material) as it is a crude oil base product, which is majorly imported in India

Risk of imports of Refractories from low-cost Chinese Refractories manufacturers as well as resins dumped by China resulting in lower capacity utilization by the Refractory Units consequently the demand for resins was depressed
Depreciation of the rupee affecting the cost of input
Any event like war, changes in prices of Coal and availability of inferior quality of Coal at customer's end and policy changes with the customer directly affect production and sales
The Company is dependent on few customers for sale of new products
Liquidity risk in meeting financial liabilities
Interest rate risk on working capital loan with floating rate
Market risk primarily from foreign exchange on imports
Concentration risk: one customer accounted for 12.25% of total revenue in FY2026
